The value of the related party transaction approved by the audit committee represents the value approved by audit committee of Jio Financial Services Limited ("JFSL") or the subsidiary, as the case may be. The value of the related party transaction approved by the audit committee is shown as '0' for transactions where approval of audit committee is not applicable as per Regulation 23 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ("SEBI LODR Regulations") or for transactions by subsidiary(ies) which are not required to constitute audit committee or for transactions of subsidiaries with parties which are not related party of concerned subsidiary. 2. Transactions in the nature of corporate actions offered to all shareholders in proportion of their shareholding by JFSL / its subsidiaries (like dividend, rights issue etc.) are not included in the above statement since the same are not related party transactions as per Regulation 2(1)(zc) of the SEBI LODR Regulations. 3. Remuneration of Non-Executive Director (Promoter Group) includes amount payable as on March 31, 2026 4. Purchase of financial products by related parties from the companies in the group are not disclosed. 5. If the amount is less than Rs. 50,000 then the figure is shown as 0.00. 6. The opening / closing balances include the amount of applicable taxes, while the transaction value excludes the applicable taxes. 7. The cost which are reimbursement in nature are excluded from the above mentioned transactions
